title: Message envelope botaru.message/v1
description: A bot message in the store: a CloudEvents 1.0 event in structured JSON. The sender writes only data.fields and data.note; the core writes all CloudEvents attributes and botaru extensions from the credentials, the attempt record and the type manifest (MSG-1). Extension names in lowercase Latin letters and digits, at most 20 characters. Within a version the envelope changes only by adding optional fields (MAN-3). The envelope gets into logs only as metadata, without data.note (MSG-3, MSG-13).

id.description: Message id m_<ulid>; the pair (source, id) is unique (IDM-4).

source.description: Sender by the credentials: /w/<worker id> or /core.

type.description: botaru.msg.<type>, for example botaru.msg.report.work.v1; the type comes from git (MSG-2).

subject.description: Catalog id from the type's subject_from field; routes are filtered by it by exact match and by prefix (MSG-16).

tenant.description: Tenant from the credentials; not accepted from the body (MSG-4).

msgto.description: Address after the check: role:<name>, group:<name>; worker:<id> only for messages that the core addressed (MSG-4).

msgdelivery.description: Delivery method of the report genus from the type (MSG-14). The state genus has no such field: a new value replaces the previous one.

replyto.description: Id of the read message this one replies to.

fromrole.description: Sender role; core for core messages.

fromworker.description: Sender worker; not shown to the model.

fromtask.description: Sender task; not shown to the model.

correlationid.description: Root of the original task tree; tree limits are counted by it (MSG-11, ORC-8).

causationid.description: The sender task or the message this one replies to.

idempotencykey.description: system:msg:<attempt>:<n>, system:report:<task>:<route> or a code key with the sender prefix (MSG-9, MSG-16).

hops.description: The sender's effective depth plus one; sending with hops greater than 5 is rejected (MSG-11).

datamark.description: Mark of the sender attempt; for code outside an attempt, the class of the type (MSG-6).

untrusted.description: Distrust flag: untrusted_seen of the attempt OR a note OR the model wrote the fields (MSG-6).

untrustedsrc.description: Sources of the flag as comma-separated codes, for example note,tool_output.

dataorigin.description: Who wrote the fields: model if the model did, including in an auto-report on an agent task; otherwise code (MSG-1).

origininitiators.description: The initiator of the root of the sender attempt and the initiators of everything it read, comma-separated (MSG-7).

fields.description: Fields by the closed schema of the type (MSG-2); here only an object, the type schema checks the leaves.

note.description: Note: a short text up to the type's note.max_chars, ceiling 500 characters; present only for report genus types that allow it; always untrusted (MSG-13).
